import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load datasets
energy = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/outlierr/2021_energy.csv')
adj = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# Strip whitespace from borough names to ensure exact matching
energy['borough'] = energy['borough'].str.strip()
adj['borough'] = adj['borough'].str.strip()
adj['neighbor'] = adj['neighbor'].str.strip()

# Exclude any boroughs with missing Energy values from all calculations
if energy['Energy_value'].isna().any():
    missing_boroughs = energy.loc[energy['Energy_value'].isna(), 'borough'].tolist()
    energy = energy.dropna(subset=['Energy_value']).reset_index(drop=True)
    adj = adj[~adj['borough'].isin(missing_boroughs) & ~adj['neighbor'].isin(missing_boroughs)]
else:
    energy = energy.reset_index(drop=True)

# Build symmetric (undirected) adjacency list
adj = adj[['borough', 'neighbor']].drop_duplicates()
adj = adj[adj['borough'] != adj['neighbor']]
adj_rev = adj.rename(columns={'borough': 'neighbor', 'neighbor': 'borough'})
adj_sym = pd.concat([adj, adj_rev], ignore_index=True).drop_duplicates()

# Keep only adjacencies where both ends exist in the energy data
valid_boroughs = set(energy['borough'])
adj_sym = adj_sym[
    adj_sym['borough'].isin(valid_boroughs) & adj_sym['neighbor'].isin(valid_boroughs)
]

# Map borough to its energy value for quick lookup
energy_map = energy.set_index('borough')['Energy_value']

# Compute neighborhood average (NeighAvg) for each borough
neigh_avg = {}
for b in energy['borough']:
    neighbors = adj_sym.loc[adj_sym['borough'] == b, 'neighbor'].values
    if len(neighbors) == 0:
        neigh_avg[b] = np.nan
    else:
        neigh_avg[b] = energy_map.loc[neighbors].mean()

energy['NeighAvg'] = energy['borough'].map(neigh_avg)

# Exclude any borough that ends up with no valid neighbors
energy = energy.dropna(subset=['NeighAvg']).reset_index(drop=True)

n = len(energy)
boroughs = energy['borough'].values
y = energy['Energy_value'].values
x = energy['NeighAvg'].values

# Iterative masking-correction loop (ITERATIVE-R style)
clean_mask = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
threshold = 3.0

while True:
    n_clean = clean_mask.sum()
    if n_clean < 3:
        break
    
    # OLS fit on current clean set (with intercept)
    X_c = np.column_stack((np.ones(n_clean), x[clean_mask]))
    y_c = y[clean_mask]
    beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X_c, y_c, rcond=None)[0]
    
    # Predictions and raw residuals for all 33 boroughs
    X_all = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), x))
    y_pred_all = X_all @ beta
    res_all = y - y_pred_all
    
    # Residual standard deviation from clean-set residuals only
    res_clean = res_all[clean_mask]
    sigma = np.sqrt(np.sum(res_clean**2) / (n_clean - 2))
    if sigma < 1e-12:
        sigma = 1e-12
    
    # Standardized residuals (z-type scores)
    z_all = res_all / sigma
    z_clean = z_all[clean_mask]
    
    max_abs_z = np.max(np.abs(z_clean))
    idx_worst = np.where(clean_mask)[0][np.argmax(np.abs(z_clean))]
    
    if max_abs_z > threshold:
        clean_mask[idx_worst] = False
    else:
        break

# Final evaluation specifically for Hammersmith and Fulham
target = "Hammersmith and Fulham"
if target not in boroughs:
    raise ValueError(f"{target} not found in dataset")
target_idx = np.where(boroughs == target)[0][0]

# Hold target out of the final regression to eliminate self-influence
model_mask = clean_mask.copy()
if model_mask[target_idx]:
    model_mask[target_idx] = False

if model_mask.sum() < 2:
    raise ValueError("Insufficient observations for final model")

X_m = np.column_stack((np.ones(model_mask.sum()), x[model_mask]))
y_m = y[model_mask]
beta_final = np.linalg.lstsq(X_m, y_m, rcond=None)[0]

# Predicted value and residual for target
x_target = np.array([1.0, x[target_idx]])
y_pred_target = x_target @ beta_final
res_target = y[target_idx] - y_pred_target

# Residual standard deviation from the model fit
res_m = y_m - (X_m @ beta_final)
sigma_final = np.sqrt(np.sum(res_m**2) / (model_mask.sum() - 2))
if sigma_final < 1e-12:
    sigma_final = 1e-12

z_target = res_target / sigma_final

# Classify based on sign and magnitude
if z_target > threshold:
    verdict = "OUTLIER - HIGH"
elif z_target < -threshold:
    verdict = "OUTLIER - LOW"
else:
    verdict = "NOT AN OUTLIER"

data_points_used = int(model_mask.sum())

print(f"data_points_used = {data_points_used}")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {verdict} (test statistic = {z_target:.6f}, significance measure = {threshold:.1f})")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {verdict} (z = {z_target:.6f})")
